items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

ctx.x: I'm trying to recognize those fellas but I'm not. He doubled.
Let's see. Hal Stringer's playing tenor there and he's got a alto and a clarinet. It's like a BAME system playing that. That must be late years. Yes. I don't recognize the other fellas.
And this big fella comes here all the time. Let's see what's his name. Uh Irishman. Sometimes he plays in St. Lafonses' Arden.
